description: Independent SHA-256/RFC 8785 ASCII history vectors. Each case starts at genesis. Commit i has repo_seq i+1, metadata below and message commit-{i}. Events use a case-wide zero-based ordinal j, item_id 019a2900-0000-7000-8000- plus 12 lowercase hex digits of j+100, event_type FOLDER::CREATE, create_item {item_type:FOLDER,name:folder- plus five decimal digits of j}. Item rows have item_seq 1 and commit_event_idx starting at zero per commit. All row timestamps equal accepted_at. Page event ranges are half-open. All non-final pages have has_more=true.
